project.name: Checkout coupon fix and tests
project.summary: Find and fix the 500 error that occurs when a coupon is applied at checkout, and add regression tests so it cannot return.

deliverables: Fix merged to the staging branch, reviewed by the client
Automated tests covering coupon scenarios (percentage, fixed, expired, stacked)
assumptions: Read and write access to the repository by 2026-12-01
A staging environment that mirrors production
One point of contact who gives consolidated feedback
